name: Kira Marie Peter-Hansen - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report does not change any law. It sets out the European Parliament's views ahead of the 2026 round of economic policy coordination between European Union countries. It asks governments to keep public finances prudent while investing more in competitiveness, defence and the green transition. It wants the European Commission to explain how it picks its country recommendations, to make them fewer and more targeted, and to add new sources of money for the European Union budget.

**Key points**

- The Parliament wants clearer, fewer country recommendations and more say for itself and local and regional bodies.
- It calls for new European Union revenue and investment tools, because the recovery fund ends in 2026.
- It asks governments to spend more on defence and climate while keeping debt under control; the Commission and Council respond next.
